backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the backend canister, defining data types (Festival, Mantra, Aarti, Shloka, Temple, CommunityPost, Katha, etc.) and initializing state maps with seeded data including Krishna Leela and 20 Vrat Kathas, while mixing in blob storage, authorization, and user approval modules.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three implemented features for the Nam Jap page: adding Radha Nam and Jai Shree Ram mantra options, fixing count persistence via localStorage and backend sync, and adding animations (ripple, entrance, and 108-completion celebration).
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON-formatted text file containing one-to-two sentence summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a reference index for the project's frontend components, pages, and hooks.
frontend/.env.example: Documents that no API key configuration is needed since the AI key is hardcoded in aiEngine.ts using Groq's free-tier API, and notes that VITE_GEMINI_API_KEY is no longer used.
frontend/index.css: Root CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for the design system's color tokens in both light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point that mounts the React app into a `#root` div and loads the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes (Home, Panchang, Jap, Mandir, Profile, Community, AartiDetail, AdminPanel, AIGuru, Kathayen, KathaDetail) wrapped in ThemeProvider and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/AartiCard.tsx: A small card component that renders an aarti's emoji, name, and color, linking to its detail page via TanStack Router.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Shared application shell providing a sticky devotional header with Om logo and login button, main content outlet, bottom navigation, profile setup modal for new authenticated users, and a footer with Caffeine attribution.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar rendering icon-and-label buttons for all main app routes, highlighting the active route with a golden glow style.
frontend/src/components/ChatMessage.tsx: Renders a single chat message bubble with user/AI avatar, timestamp, and basic markdown-like formatting (bold, newlines).
frontend/src/components/ChatTypingIndica: Displays an animated three-dot typing indicator with the AI guru avatar, shown while the AI is generating a response.
frontend/src/components/DailyDharmaQuote: Fetches and displays a daily dharma quote in Hindi and English with a fallback quote and loading skeleton.
frontend/src/components/FestivalCountdow: Shows the next upcoming Hindu festival with a days-remaining countdown and a button to download a shareable festival card generated via Canvas.
frontend/src/components/FloatingLotus.ts: Renders decorative floating lotus petal images as a fixed background layer with CSS keyframe animations.
frontend/src/components/GoldenHalo.tsx: Wraps children in a pulsing radial-gradient golden halo effect with configurable size.
frontend/src/components/KathaCard.tsx: Displays a linked card for a Katha (story) entry with category badge, deity label, title, and a truncated Hindi text preview.
frontend/src/components/Loader.tsx: Shows a spinning mandala image with an Om symbol overlay and optional loading text in configurable sizes.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Handles Internet Identity login/logout with loading state, clearing the React Query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/LotusBloomOverla: Full-screen celebratory overlay triggered when a 108-bead mala is completed, featuring lotus bloom animation, petal burst particles, and Sanskrit text.
frontend/src/components/MalaRing.tsx: Canvas-based animated mala (prayer bead ring) that visually fills 108 beads based on the current count, with a slow rotation and central Om symbol.
Short-lived particle burst animation that emits three Om symbols outward from the center, auto-hiding after 700ms.
frontend/src/components/PremiumBanner.ts: Displays a dismissible premium upgrade banner with benefits list and a styled CTA button; dismissal state is persisted in sessionStorage.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog that collects a user's name on first setup and saves it as a UserProfile via the useSetUserProfile mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/SacredRipple.tsx: Renders animated concentric ripple rings centered on the component whenever the trigger prop changes, auto-cleaning after 800ms.
frontend/src/components/ShlokaCard.tsx: Displays a Sanskrit shloka with Hindi/English meanings and provides copy, share, and canvas-based image download actions.
frontend/src/components/VratModeDashboar: Dashboard for fasting/vrat tracking showing Brahma Muhurat time, a daily fasting check-in button, and countdown timers for upcoming Hindu observances.
frontend/src/components/VratModeToggle.t: A toggle switch component that enables or disables Vrat Mode, updating its border and label styling based on the enabled state.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAIChat.ts: Custom hook managing AI chat state including message history, loading state, sending messages via getAIResponse, and clearing the conversation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions and status flags. Includes an `InternetIdentityProvider` component that persists identity across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend actor interactions including user profiles, jap counter, dharma quotes, festivals, and kathas. Uses `useActor` to access the canister actor and exposes both query and mutation hooks.
frontend/src/hooks/useSpeechNarration.ts: Custom hook wrapping the Web Speech API to provide text-to-speech narration with play, pause, resume, and stop controls. Defaults to Hindi (hi-IN) voice with fallback handling for unsupported voices.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet importing Google Fonts and configuring Tailwind CSS with custom CSS variables for a devotional/spiritual theme including saffron, gold, and maroon color tokens in both light and dark modes. Also defines custom keyframe animations like lotus floating, diya flickering, and mandala spinning.
frontend/src/lib/aiEngine.ts: Implements a local spiritual AI response engine with predefined Hindi responses categorized by topics such as meditation, mantras, dharma, Krishna, Shiva, and yoga. Optionally enhances responses via the Groq API.
frontend/src/lib/aiGuruData.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces and static data for a Hindu astrology AI guru feature, including rashi (zodiac) info for all 12 signs and prediction templates for love, career, and other life aspects in Hindi.
frontend/src/lib/kathaData.ts: Contains static data for Hindu religious stories (kathas), including a detailed Krishna Leela narrative in Hindi with full story content, metadata like category, deity, and tags.
frontend/src/lib/panchangEngine.ts: Implements accurate Hindu calendar (Panchang) calculations using astronomical algorithms from Jean Meeus, computing sun/moon positions, Julian Day Numbers, and related values for IST timezone centered on Central India.
frontend/src/lib/staticData.ts: Provides static data for Hindu aartis (devotional hymns) including Ganesh, Shiv, and Vishnu aartis in both Hindi and English transliteration, along with TypeScript interfaces for Shloka and AartiData.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React application entry point that bootstraps the app with React Query, Internet Identity authentication provider, and mounts the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AartiDetail.tsx: Displays a detailed view of a single aarti fetched from static data, with Hindi/English language toggle, copy-to-clipboard, and native share functionality.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin-only panel that allows managing user approvals, assigning roles, and adding dharma quotes, with access gated by an admin check via Internet Identity.
frontend/src/pages/AIGuru.tsx: React page component for an AI spiritual guru chat interface, featuring a message list, auto-resizing textarea input, suggested questions in Hindi, and scroll-to-bottom functionality.
frontend/src/pages/Community.tsx: Community feed page showing seed posts with like/report actions, a compose dialog for new posts, and approval-request flow for authenticated users.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Authenticated user dashboard that redirects unauthenticated users to home, shows a welcome message with profile data, and triggers a profile setup modal if no profile exists.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Main home screen displaying a hero section with greeting, daily panchang info, a dharma quote, featured aartis, and upcoming festivals with animated background elements.
frontend/src/pages/Jap.tsx: Jap (mantra chanting) counter page with a 108-bead mala ring, multi-mantra selector, local-storage persistence for guest users, and batched backend sync for authenticated users.
frontend/src/pages/KathaDetail.tsx: Detail page for a single Katha (sacred story) that displays Hindi/English text with language toggle, and supports text-to-speech narration using the useSpeechNarration hook. Falls back to static data if the backend returns nothing, and handles Ramayan/Krishna Leela kathas as Hindi-only.
frontend/src/pages/Kathayen.tsx: Listing page for all Kathas with search input and category tabs (All, Puranik, Vrat), falling back to static data if the backend returns no results. Displays a hero banner and renders each katha as a KathaCard component.
frontend/src/pages/Mandir.tsx: Temple finder page that provides a Google Maps link to locate nearby Hindu temples and displays a static list of famous temples with live darshan and directions buttons.
frontend/src/pages/Panchang.tsx: Hindu calendar (Panchang) page showing daily astronomical and religious data (tithi, nakshatra, sunrise/sunset, etc.) for a user-selected date with day navigation, plus upcoming festivals fetched from the backend.
frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx: User profile page allowing selection of a personal mantra (saved to backend if authenticated, otherwise localStorage) and displaying jap stats. Supports Internet Identity login/logout and a vrat mode toggle.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining a devotional color palette (saffron, gold, maroon, cream), custom fonts, border radii, shadows, and background images for the Nam Jap app.
project_state.json: Project state metadata for the Nam Jap chanting counter app, tracking existing features, known issues (count not saving, missing name options), and pending feature requests for animations, count persistence, and additional mantra options.
